capabilities: Install SRD 5.2.1 rules notes into chosen folders
Browse spells, monsters, items and classes as Bases catalogs
Build and level up characters from the rules notes
Import a character from D&D Beyond by link or saved file
Roll characters into an Atlas VTT scene
disambiguation: Not a ready-made vault of notes; it is a plugin that writes the SRD notes into the vault you already have.
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.11.4 or later. The rules notes ship inside the plugin and nothing is downloaded; re-installing keeps edited notes and never deletes anything. It contacts D&D Beyond only when you import by link, and checks for updates hourly unless switched off. The SRD text is generated and corrected, not a word-for-word copy.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in fifth edition rules reference, character sheet or way to bring a D&D Beyond character into the vault.

relations.evidence: Rolls go through the Atlas VTT plugin when it is installed.
A character you play on D&D Beyond can become a character here, from its link or from a file you save.

summary: Installs the SRD 5.2.1 into a vault as linked notes, browses them as Bases catalogs, builds characters from them and rolls those into Atlas VTT.
